scripts.precommit: bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.dev: CONTENT_SOURCE=strapi concurrently -n web,cms -c cyan,green "bun run --cwd apps/web dev" "bun run --cwd apps/cms develop"
scripts.build: bun run lint && bun run build:cms && bun run build:web
scripts.build:static: bun run lint && bun run --cwd apps/web --env-file=../../.env build:static
scripts.test: bun run test:sync-content && bun run test:unit && bun run test:browser && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:install-browser: bun run --cwd apps/web playwright install chromium
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/cms typecheck && bun run typecheck:sync-content
scripts.typecheck:sync-content: tsc --noEmit --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --strict --noImplicitAny --noImplicitOverride --noImplicitReturns --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --skipLibCheck --types bun scripts/sync-content.ts scripts/sync-content.test.ts
scripts.lint: bun run format:check && eslint apps/web/src apps/web/tests scripts apps/cms/src && bun run typecheck
